emails.title: Emails to check
emails.description: One email per line. You can paste thousands, they are checked in bulk. Bare domains (e.g. shopify.com) work too and get a domain level report.

checkSenderSetup.title: Check sender setup (SPF and DMARC)
checkSenderSetup.description: Also check whether each domain has SPF and DMARC records. Useful when you want to know if a domain takes email seriously.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on emails checked. Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free.
